_meta.correction: Supersedes the single-root picture in RESULT_B01 §4 and PAPER_SKELETON REV-1 (b): AT LEAST two roots. The NMC-grain-boundary branch starts at Xu et al. 2018 ('We set'); the 2012 spinel paper reaches only M05. The second parent of M05, Zhang & Guo 2018, is unopened and could be a third root. | 2026-09-28: full text still paywalled; its public reference list (Springer page) includes Zhu, Park & Sastry 2012, so ZG18 is probably a relay of ZHU12 rather than a third root (raised by Gemini review, M1). | 2026-09-28 (later): CONFIRMED from the full text (user-supplied PDF): ZG18 Table 1 gives σTS = 100 MPa citing [23] = Zhu, Park & Sastry 2012; ZG18 is a relay of ZHU12, NOT a third root. Roots are exactly two: M12 (Xu 2018) and ZHU12. The branches are not independent: M05 also cites Xu et al. 2018 (its ref [50]) for the fracture energy. | 2026-09-24: M13 (Li et al. 2025) added as a child of M05 (explicit citation in its Table 1).
